basis: Jinshu:053 names 王戎 as 太傅 among 盛選德望以為師傅 for 愍懷太子 after 惠帝即位.
Songshu:073 names the same 王戎 among 竹林七賢, omitted with 山濤 because 以貴顯被黜.
Full personal name 王戎 plus attested rise to prominence matches the Hui-court grand mentor; retain the whole preexisting Jin 王戎 group.
Both sides attest the full personal name 王戎, not a shared English romanization.
Jinshu 53: 王戎 appointed 太傅 after Hui Di established Crown Prince Yu.
Jinshu 35: 綏父戎 and 頠比王戎 among the eight Wangs of 魏晉, with 王綏 a separate analogue, matching Western Jin 王戎 as 王綏's father.
notes: Songshu's Bamboo Grove 王戎 omitted from 五君詠 for 貴顯 is the same Western Jin 王戎 who appears as 太傅 to 愍懷太子. Identical personal name plus high-office prominence; no rival 王戎 is supplied.

Jinshu 53 names 王戎 太傅 of Crown Prince Minhuai under Hui Di. Jinshu 35 names 戎 as 王綏's father and lists 王戎 among the eight Wangs of Wei-Jin, treating 王綏 as a distinct analogue. Same full name plus kinship and Wei-Jin court context identify one Western Jin 王戎. Preexisting group membership is retained in full.

basis: Jinshu names 王戎 as 太傅 to Crown Prince 遹.
Tongjian names 立嗣子融, Li's heir Rong, arrested and driven to suicide.
No 王 surname or alias chain joins 融 to 王戎.
notes: Han annal 立嗣子融 is Li's heir, later 吏捕融, 立令融自殺. Jin 王戎 is appointed 太傅 beside 何劭 and 楊濟 under 惠帝. Shared English Wang Rong is not a primary name. Keep separate.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Western Jin 太傅.
Jiu Tangshu names 鎮州王鎔, a child warlord who 父事 Kuangwei.
鎔 and 戎 are distinct given names without an alias chain.
notes: 景福初，鎮州王鎔誘河東將李存孝, and 時鎔童幼. This late-Tang Zhenzhou 王鎔 cannot be the Jin crown-prince 太傅 王戎. Do not collapse 鎔 into 戎 by romanization.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅.
Weishu identifies 融 as 肅長兄, father of 誦.
融 versus 戎, and Langye 王肅 kinship, are unshared.
notes: Weishu: 誦，字國章，肅長兄融之子. Neighboring 王肅 supplies the surname; this 融 is Su's elder brother, not Jin 太傅 王戎. Character and family contradict a merge.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 to 愍懷太子.
Nanshi 王融 is Qi 甯朔將軍/軍主 under 子良, later 詔于獄賜死, 時年二十七.
融 ≠ 戎; Qi plot and execution are not the Jin tutorship.
notes: Nanshi appoints 融 甯朔將軍、軍主 for 竟陵王子良, then 欲矯詔立子良 and 賜死 at twenty-seven. Jin 王戎 is 太傅 in 惠帝's heir-tutors list. Distinct name and career.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Xin Tangshu 王镕 領河東東面 as 行營招討使 against 克用, with 全忠 and 李匡威.
镕 ≠ 戎.
notes: Dashun-era campaign text: 王镕領河東東面，全忠南面，李匡威北面，並為行營招討使. Late-Tang Hedong commander 王镕 is not Western Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Xin Wudai shi 趙王王镕 of the Chengde 王氏, Uyghur 阿布思 line via 王武俊.
镕 ≠ 戎; Zhao kingship is unshared.
notes: Biography opens 王镕，其先回鶻阿布思之遺種 and later 趙王王镕求救於守光. This Zhao ruler is not the Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Xin Wudai shi 王榮 is posted by 錢镠 to hold gates with 馬綽 and 杜建徽.
榮 ≠ 戎.
notes: 吳越世家: 镠…遣馬綽、王榮、杜建徽等分屯諸門. Gate officer 王榮 under Qian Liu is not Jin 太傅 王戎. Distinct character and theater.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Xin Wudai shi 趙王王熔 乞師於晉; Jin sends 德威 to 趙州.
熔 ≠ 戎.
notes: 天祐七年梁擊趙: 趙王王熔乞師於晉，晉遣德威先屯趙州. Zhao king 王熔 seeking Jin aid is not Western Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Jiu Wudai shi 王镕 乞師於守光 and is 鎮州節度使 among those who 推守光為尚父.
镕 ≠ 戎.
notes: 及梁軍據深、冀，王镕乞師於守光, later 鎮州節度使王镕 jointly 奉冊推守光為尚父. This Zhenzhou 王镕 is not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Jiu Wudai shi: 張文禮殺其帥王鎔; 趙王 is mourned as 遇弑.
鎔 ≠ 戎.
notes: 鎮州大將張文禮殺其帥王鎔, and 聞鎔遇弑 with 趙王與吾把臂同盟. Assassinated Zhao/Zhen commander 王鎔 is not Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Nanshi 王融 is executed under 郁林; 元履 與王融遊狎.
融 ≠ 戎.
notes: 與王融遊狎，及王融誅，郁林敕元履…密令於北殺之. Qi 王融 whose execution triggers a secret killing order is not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Same Zhenzhou narrative: 王鎔令偏將符習 follow the emperor; 文禮既行弑逆.
鎔 ≠ 戎.
notes: 初，王鎔令偏將符習以本部兵從帝屯於德勝, then 文禮既行弑逆，忌鎔故將. This is the murdered Zhen lord 王鎔, not Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Mingshi 寧夏參將王榮 jointly 舉其過 of 史昭.
榮 ≠ 戎; Ming Ningxia office is unshared.
notes: 兵部尚書王驥、寧夏參將王榮嘗舉其過. Ming assistant commander 王榮 reporting 史昭 is not Western Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Songshi 濱州防禦使王榮 削籍流均州.
榮 ≠ 戎.
notes: 己未，濱州防禦使王榮削籍流均州 in Zhenzong annals. Song defense commissioner 王榮 is not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Yuanshi 同僚王榮 潛畜異志 against 純只海 and is killed.
榮 ≠ 戎.
notes: 己亥，同僚王榮潛畜異志，欲殺純只海; later troops 討榮，殺之. This 王榮 is not Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Nan Qishu: 竟陵王子良謂王融曰 about 府二上佐; 融 replies.
融 ≠ 戎.
notes: 府公竟陵王子良謂王融曰：「我府二上佐…」融曰：「兩賢同時…」. Qi interlocutor 王融 of 子良's staff is not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Xin Wudai shi: 趙將張文禮弒其君镕; 镕 is the Zhao lord, abbreviated from 王镕.
镕 ≠ 戎.
notes: 趙將張文禮弒其君镕，文禮來請命. Opening 君镕 is the Zhao ruler (王镕), not Jin 王戎. Bare 镕 is identified from this assassination context.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Shiji names 王容 with 傅豹 and 蘇射 leading a Yan revolt at 武垣.
容 ≠ 戎; English Wang Rong is romanization only.
notes: 武垣令傅豹、王容、蘇射率燕眾反燕地. Warring-States 王容 is a distinct graph from Jin 王戎. Do not merge on shared English Wang Rong.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Xin Wudai shi attests 趙王王镕 who retained 鏻; 張文禮弒镕自立.
王镕 ≠ 王戎.
notes: 弘規進之趙王王镕，镕留為從事, then 張文禮弒镕自立. Zhao king 王镕 is not Jin 太傅 王戎. Claim zh was missing; Chinese name is 王镕.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Xin Tangshu: edict 詔王镕擇五十人為敕使 after inner eunuchs are dismissed.
镕 ≠ 戎.
notes: 胤以鎮人性謹厚，即詔王镕擇五十人為敕使. Tang 王镕 selecting provincial 敕使 is not Western Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Jin 太傅.
Nanshi 琅邪王融 is 一時才俊 who 後果陷於法.
融 ≠ 戎; Langya Qi literatus versus Jin tutor.
notes: 時琅邪王融一時才俊…融後果陷於法. Langya 王融 who later fell to the law is the Qi literatus, not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jin source names 王戎 as 太傅 to Crown Prince Yu under Hui.
Liangshu names 琅邪王融, Qi 中書郎 who recommended Kong Xiuyuan.
Given names 戎 vs 融; no alias chain.
notes: Western Jin 王戎 is 太傅 of Minhuai; Liangshu 王融 of Langya is a Qi 中書郎 recommending Kong Xiuyuan and Jiang Ge. Distinct graphs 戎/融 and no attested alias.

basis: Jin 王戎 is Hui-era 太傅.
Nanshi names 齊中書郎王融 who esteemed Jiang Ge.
戎 vs 融; Qi vs Western Jin.
notes: Jin 王戎 tutors the heir as 太傅. Nanshi’s 王融 is Qi 中書郎 with Xie Tiao, urging Hu Xiezhi to recommend Jiang Ge. Different given names and courts; no linking alias.

basis: Jin names 王戎 太傅.
Xin Wudai shi names 趙王王镕 who appointed Xiao Xifu 參軍.
戎 vs 镕; Jin court vs Zhenzhou Zhao.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅 of the Western Jin heir. Xin Wudai shi 王镕 is 趙王 at Zhenzhou who made Xiao Xifu 參軍. Distinct personal names and no alias chain.

basis: Jin 王戎 is 太傅.
Jiu Wudai shi: 張文禮殺王鎔叛.
戎 vs 鎔.
notes: Jin 王戎 serves as 太傅. Jiu Wudai shi records 王鎔 killed by Zhang Wenli, after which Yan Bao campaigns. Different graphs and roles; no identification as one person.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅 of Yu.
Xin Wudai shi biography: 王镕 of Chengde, 趙王, killed Tianyou 18.
Uyghur-Wang lineage vs Jin minister.
notes: Jin 王戎 is Hui’s 太傅. Xin Wudai shi 王镕 descends from Chengde 王氏, is 趙王, and is beheaded when Zhang Wenli revolts. Names 戎 vs 镕; separate lineages.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Qingshi gao lists 把總王榮 among Zhapu dead.
戎 vs 榮.
notes: Jin 王戎 is Western Jin 太傅. Qingshi gao 把總王榮 dies with the Zhapu garrison. Distinct given name 榮 and Qing military context; English Wang Rong is not identity proof.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Liangshu 太守王嶸 of Guiyang favored Zhou Xingsi.
戎 vs 嶸.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Liangshu 王嶸 is 桂陽太守 who treated Zhou Xingsi generously before Gaozu’s accession. Different characters 戎/嶸; romanization Wang Rong is not a merge.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Khitan appendix: 故趙王王镕, six generations of Zhao, Zhenzhou.
戎 vs 镕.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Xin Wudai shi calls 故趙王王镕 ruler of Zhao for six generations at Zhenzhou, whose city Zhang Wenli seized. Separate name and polity from the Jin tutor.

basis: Jin 王戎 is Hui 太傅.
Xin Tangshu 王戎 is 林士弘’s 司空, later 南昌州總管.
Same graphs 王戎 but Sui-Tang partisan vs Western Jin tutor; no alias linking them.
notes: Both are written 王戎, but Jin 王戎 is 太傅 of Crown Prince Yu, while Xin Tangshu 王戎 is 林士弘’s 司空 who later offers Nanchang and is made 南昌州總管. Same spelling is not an alias chain; keep separate.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Xin Tangshu 王镕 is then friendly with Bian; Li Keyong writes him.
戎 vs 镕.
notes: Jin 王戎 is Western Jin 太傅. Xin Tangshu 王镕 is on good terms with Bian when Li Keyong asks him to take the lead in reconciling with Zhu Quanzhong. Distinct name 镕 and late-Tang Zhenzhou setting.

basis: Jin 王戎 is 太傅.
Xin Tangshu: 張善安掠孫州，執總管王戎.
Homograph 王戎; Tang 總管 vs Jin 太傅.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅 under Hui. Xin Tangshu 總管王戎 is seized by Zhang Shian at Sunzhou in Wude. Homographic 王戎 without shared office, kin, or alias; not the Jin tutor.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Liangshu: Qi Yongming 文士王融 with Xie Tiao and Shen Yue using 四聲.
戎 vs 融.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Liangshu 王融 is a Qi Yongming 文士 who, with Xie Tiao and Shen Yue, first used the four tones. Distinct given name 融 and literary Qi setting.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Weishu: 蕭賾’s 祕書丞王融 praised Song Bian with Xiao Ziliang.
戎 vs 融.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅 of Minhuai. Weishu 王融 is Xiao Ze’s 祕書丞 who, with 司徒蕭子良, praised Song Bian. Different graph 融 and Southern Qi court.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Zizhi tongjian: 王融 plotted to change the heir; 融 sought wealth, harming Ziliang.
戎 vs 融.
notes: Jin 王戎 is appointed 太傅 to the Jin heir. Zizhi tongjian 王融 ‘乘危徼幸，謀易嗣君,’ and the comment names 融 as causing 子良’s worry. Distinct 融 and Qi succession plot.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Jiu Wudai shi 鎮州王鎔 with sons 昭祚、昭誨 welcomes Zhuangzong.
戎 vs 鎔.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Jiu Wudai shi 鎮州王鎔, with sons 昭祚 and 昭誨, meets Zhuangzong and had been 尚書令 under Liang. Name 鎔 and Zhenzhou warlord context.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Same annals: 王熔告急於周德威; 帝會王鎔於天長.
Packet attests 熔 as variant of this 鎔, not of Jin 戎.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Jiu Wudai shi writes 王熔 seeking Zhou Dewei’s aid and 帝會王鎔於天長. Primary 鎔/熔 is the Zhenzhou ruler, not Jin 王戎.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Xin Tangshu 鎮冀節度使王鎔 hosted Xiao Lin’s clan in Hebei.
戎 vs 鎔.
notes: Jin 王戎 is Western Jin 太傅. Xin Tangshu 鎮冀節度使王鎔 courteously received Xiao Lin fleeing to Hebei when the Prince of Xiang seized power. Distinct 鎔 and late-Tang Zhenji office.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Liangshu 琅邪王融 in Jingling’s salon with Shen Yue, Xie Tiao.
戎 vs 融.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Liangshu 琅邪王融 associates with Shen Yue at the Prince of Jingling’s gathering, called 得人. Personal name 融 and Langye Qi literary circle, not the Jin tutor.

basis: Jinshu 53: 王戎為太傅 of the heir.
Jinshu 86: 長史王融 tears Zhang Zhen’s proclamation to Zhang Gui.
Same book and dynasty but 戎 vs 融; no source equates them.
notes: Both appear in Jinshu in Western Jin, but ch.53 王戎 is 太傅 of Yu while ch.86 長史王融 remonstrates with Zhang Gui. Explicit names differ (戎/融) with no stated variant or alias.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Nanshi groups 沈約、王融 as useless for clerkly government.
戎 vs 融.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Nanshi cites 沈約、王融 among hundreds of literary men contrasted with clerks. The graph is 融, paired with Shen Yue, not Jin 王戎.

basis: Jin 王戎 is personal name 王戎, office 太傅.
Nanshi unit names 元長, not 王戎; 元長 is a courtesy, not the Jin personal name.
No chain from 元長 to 王戎.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. The Nanshi sentence contrasts 僧達 with 元長’s restlessness and never writes 王戎. 元長 is a courtesy name, not an attested alias of Jin 王戎; keep separate.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Jiu Wudai shi: 獲刺史王鋋 at Zhaozhou, eighth month of year 18.
戎 vs 鋋; English Wang Rong is wrong romanization, not identity.
notes: Jin 王戎 is 太傅. Jiu Wudai shi captures 刺史王鋋 when recovering Zhaozhou in the campaign against Zhang Wenli. Graph 鋋 is not 戎; the English ‘Wang Rong’ is a romanization error, not a personal-name match.

basis: Jin 王戎 太傅.
Nanshi 舅齊中書郎王融 of Liu Xiaochuo, who called him 神童.
戎 vs 融.
notes: Jin 王戎 is Hui-era 太傅. Nanshi 王融 is Qi 中書郎, maternal uncle of Liu Xiaochuo, riding with the child and claiming literary primacy. Distinct 融 and Qi kinship; not the Jin tutor.

basis: Jinshu names 王戎 as 太傅 to Crown Prince Minhuai after 惠帝即位.
Xin Wudai shi names 王镕, murdered by 張文禮, in a Later Tang campaign narrative.
Distinct personal-name characters 戎 vs 镕; no alias chain linking them.
notes: Western Jin tutor 王戎 is not the Five Dynasties 王镕 killed by Zhang Wenli. Shared English Wang Rong is not identity proof.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is appointed 太傅 in the Hui-era Eastern Palace tutor slate.
Xin Wudai shi has 鎮州張文禮殺王镕, a Zhenzhou killing in the Liang–Jin struggle.
Personal names 王戎 and 王镕 differ; no shared kinship or office chain.
notes: Target 王戎 is a Western Jin grand mentor. Counterpart 王镕 is the Zhenzhou lord murdered by Zhang Wenli. Different graphs and settings.

basis: Jinshu names 王戎 as 太傅 among 愍懷太子's 師傅.
Yuanshi names 金懷州元帥王榮 who surrendered a city with Pei Shouqian and Wang Zhen.
Characters 戎 vs 榮; Jin-dynasty Huaizhou commander is not Western Jin 太傅.
notes: 王榮 the Jin (Jurchen) Huaizhou commander who surrendered is a different personal name and war from Hui-era 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 holds 太傅 for 愍懷太子 under 惠帝.
Zizhi tongjian 王融 is 法曹參軍 among the 八友 and 僧達之孫.
融 vs 戎; Qi literary official, grandson of Sengda, is a distinct person.
notes: Southern Qi 法曹參軍 王融, Sengda's grandson and one of the Eight Friends, is not Western Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 in the crown-prince tutor appointment.
Jiu Wudai shi campaigns 以討王熔為名 in a Weibo/Liang annal.
熔 vs 戎; no identification of the Liang-era Zhen target as the Jin tutor.
notes: Liang-court campaign against 王熔 is a Five Dynasties warlord, not Hui-era 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu writes 王戎為太傅 for 愍懷太子.
Jiu Wudai shi writes 王钅容危懾,送款於太祖 at Changshan in 光化三年.
Given graph 钅容 (not 戎); Tang-end Zhen submission is a different life.
notes: The Changshan submitter written 王钅容 under 光化三年 is not Western Jin 太傅 王戎. Do not equate via English Wang Rong.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅, not a Zhao king.
Xin Wudai shi: 張文禮弒趙王王镕.
王镕 vs 王戎; murder of Zhao king is Five Dynasties, not Jin court tutoring.
notes: Zhao king 王镕 murdered by Zhang Wenli is a different name and polity from Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 serves as 太傅 after 惠帝即位.
Xin Tangshu: 景福初，鎮州王镕攻堯山 against Li Keyong.
王镕 of Zhenzhou vs 王戎; late Tang Shatuo wars, not Jin Eastern Palace.
notes: Zhenzhou 王镕 attacking Yaoshan in Jingfu is a late-Tang governor, not Hui-era 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu names 王戎 as 太傅.
Nanshi: 時琅邪王融有才俊, a Langya litterateur beside Ren Fang.
王融 vs 王戎; Qi literary rivalry is not the Jin tutor post.
notes: Langya 王融 who thought himself unmatched until seeing Ren Fang's prose is Qi 王融, not Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 to the Jin heir.
Xin Wudai shi has 成德王镕 and 趙王王镕 in Liu Shouguang / Jin-prince narratives.
王镕 vs 王戎; Zhao/Chengde warlord is not the Jin tutor.
notes: Chengde/Zhao 王镕 who banqueted the Jin prince is Five Dynasties 王镕, not 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Eastern Palace 太傅.
Xin Wudai shi: attack on 鎮州, 王熔乞盟 with Liang Taizu.
王熔 vs 王戎; Zhenzhou suing for peace is a different person.
notes: Zhenzhou 王熔 who begged a pact after Lincheng fell is not Western Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu writes 王戎為太傅.
Xin Wudai shi: 太祖北攻鎮州，與王鎔和, then 遣捍見鎔.
王鎔 vs 王戎; Liang–Zhenzhou peace embassy is not Jin tutoring.
notes: Zhenzhou 王鎔 who made peace with Liang Taizu and received Liu Han is not 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 for 愍懷太子.
Nanshi: 琅邪王融 recommended Kong Xiuyuan to 司徒竟陵王 as 西邸學士.
王融 vs 王戎; Jingling Western Lodge is Southern Qi, not Western Jin.
notes: Langya 王融 of Prince Jingling's Western Lodge is Qi 王融, not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is a selected 太傅 of virtue and repute.
Nanshi favorites: 王融奸謀潛構, a secret plot checked by Zhenzhi.
王融 vs 王戎; Qi court intrigue vs Jin heir's tutor slate.
notes: The 王融 accused of secret treachery in the Nanshi favorites chapter is not Hui-era 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 at the Jin Eastern Palace.
Songshi: 守正大醉，與王榮論邊功於駕前 at a 北苑 feast.
王榮 vs 王戎; Song palace-front quarrel over frontier merit is another man.
notes: Song 王榮 who drunkenly disputed frontier merit at Xuanwu Gate is 榮, not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅, not a Zhenzhou lord avenged by retainers.
Jiu Wudai shi: 張文禮弑王鎔, a subordinate vows 復主讎.
王鎔 vs 王戎; Five Dynasties murder and revenge.
notes: 王鎔 murdered by Zhang Wenli, whose officer sought revenge, is not Western Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 in a Jin tutor list with He Shao and Yang Ji.
Xin Tangshu: 及王镕詘服，拔定州 in Zhu Quanzhong's campaign against Wang Ke.
王镕 vs 王戎; late-Tang submission, not Jin 師傅.
notes: The 王镕 who submitted before Dingzhou fell is a late-Tang Hebei governor, not 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅; no courtesy 元長 and no Sengda grandson heading.
Nanshi Wang Hong bio: 僧達孫 融, 融字元長, Qi offices 太子舍人, 司徒法曹.
王融 courtesy 元長 vs 王戎; distinct personal names and Qi career.
notes: Qi 王融, courtesy 元長, grandson of 僧達, is not Western Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 to 愍懷太子.
Xin Wudai shi: Liang attacked 王鎔; later 張文禮弒王镕.
鎔/镕 vs 戎; Zhao–Jin–Liang wars, not Jin Eastern Palace.
notes: Zhao 王鎔/王镕 who sought Jin aid and was murdered by Zhang Wenli is not 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is appointed 太傅 after 惠帝即位.
Xin Wudai shi: 文德元年，方立乞兵于王鎔以攻晉.
王鎔 vs 王戎; late-Tang troop request, not Jin tutoring.
notes: The 王鎔 who promised Meng Fangli troops in Wende 1 is not Hui-era 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅, not 節度使 or 趙王.
Jiu Wudai shi: Fu Xi 事節度使王鎔; 鎔為張文禮所害; 趙王 misjudged Wenli.
王鎔 vs 王戎; Zhao military commissioner murdered by Zhang Wenli.
notes: Zhao 節度使/趙王 王鎔, Fu Xi's lord murdered by Zhang Wenli, is not Jin 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 in Luoyang Eastern Palace staffing.
Xin Wudai shi: 還攻王熔於鎮州，入其城中.
王熔 vs 王戎; Liang assault on Zhenzhou, not Jin 師傅.
notes: Liang troops attacking 王熔 at Zhenzhou and seizing livestock is not the career of 太傅 王戎.

basis: Jinshu 王戎 is Western Jin 太傅.
Weishu note cites 南齊書卷四七王融傳 and 戎服絳衫, the Southern Qi 王融 biography.
王融 vs 王戎; the cited Qi biography is not the Jin tutor.
notes: The 王融 of Nan Qi shu juan 47 (crimson military shirt) cited in the Weishu note is Qi 王融, not Jin 王戎.

basis: Jinshu attests 王戎 as 太傅 of the Hui-Di crown prince.
Xinwudaishi attests 王镕/鎔, son of 景崇, Chengde successor made 趙王; Uyghur-origin Wang Wujun line.
戎 and 镕/鎔 are distinct given-name characters with no supplied alias chain.
notes: Jinshu 王戎 is Hui Di's 太傅. Xinwudaishi 王镕/鎔 inherited Chengde at age ten from 景崇 and was later 趙王. Different personal names and lineages; English Wang Rong is not identity proof.

basis: Jinshu attests 王戎 as 太傅.
Songshi attests 王榮 among frontier supply-route defeats with 曹光實、白守榮、馬紹忠.
戎 vs 榮 are distinct characters; no alias chain.
notes: Jinshu 王戎 is the Hui-Di 太傅. Songshi 王榮 appears only as a defeated commander with Cao Guangshi and others. Different given names 戎 and 榮; romanization Wang Rong does not merge them.

basis: Jinshu attests 王戎 as Western Jin 太傅.
Xintangshu attests 王镕 sending 三萬 troops after 方立 begged aid.
戎 vs 镕; no alias or shared office linking them.
notes: Jinshu 王戎 is 太傅 for Crown Prince Yu. Xintangshu 王镕 is the commander 方立 asked for 30,000 men. Distinct characters 戎 and 镕; English Wang Rong is not proof they are one person.

basis: Jinshu attests 王戎 as 太傅.
Songshi attests 王鎔請盟 when 梁祖舉河南 and Hebei slipped away.
戎 vs 鎔; no alias chain to the Jin 太傅.
notes: Jinshu 王戎 is Hui Di's 太傅. Songshi 王鎔 requested alliance as Liang rose in Henan and Hebei was lost. Distinct characters 戎 and 鎔; shared English Wang Rong is not an alias chain.

basis: Jinshu attests 王戎 as 太傅.
Nanqishu attests 王融敗後, after which guests joined Wang Sengqian's son 寂; 建武 follows.
戎 vs 融; no alias chain.
notes: Jinshu 王戎 is Western Jin 太傅. Nanqishu 王融 is the man whose defeat sent clients to 王寂, in a Southern Qi 建武 narrative. Distinct character 融; do not infer identity from English Wang Rong.
